name: Argyle
author: Erin Carter
description: Two families of diagonal glowing tubes cross into a diamond weave, one riding brighter over the other so the lattice reads as woven luminous cord. Charge travels each diagonal and the hue shifts diamond to diamond over a softly lit ground.

params.label: Diamond size
params.effect: Size of each woven diamond in CSS pixels - a fine tight weave at the minimum, broad open lattice at the maximum.

params.label: Tube weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing cord in CSS pixels, from a hairline thread to a fat neon rope.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge travelling the diagonals; 0 freezes the light as static beads, high sends it weaving across the frame.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around each cord; low is a crisp drawn weave, high a luminous bloom that fills the diamonds with colour.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Turns the weave; 0 is a diagonal diamond lattice, 45 an upright basket weave, anything between a tilted mesh.

params.label: Pattern
params.effect: Re-rolls the colour mix and the per-cord depth and scatter into a fresh arrangement of the weave.

params.label: Colour blend
params.effect: How the cord colours join across diamonds; 0 hard-switches the hue at every diamond a cord crosses, 1 blends them into one smooth continuous colour field.

params.label: Scatter
params.effect: Nudges each cord off the regular weave; 0 is a perfect lattice, higher scatters the diagonals into an irregular hand-woven mesh.

params.label: Depth
params.effect: Spreads the cords across depth; 0 holds them all on one plane, higher makes some cords read as near (bright and fat) and others far (dim and thin) for a layered weave.
